title: Flood evacuation
message: Fictional drill: A flood threatens Rampur village near the river bank. Evacuate to the school building by 6 PM today, 17 August 2030. Water is expected to rise 2 metres.

facts.location: Rampur village near the river bank

title: Cyclone shelter
message: Fictional drill: A cyclone threatens Neelpur coastal village. Move to the community shelter by 9 AM today, 5 September 2030. Winds may reach 120 kilometres per hour.

title: Heatwave advisory
message: Fictional drill: A heatwave affects Surajpur town. Stay indoors from 12 PM today, 12 May 2030. The temperature may reach 45 degrees Celsius. Carry drinking water if travel is essential.
